reason: Cline preparation blocked: blocked: issue #107 reports a wallet-level signing failure, not a reproducible defect in this repository. Funding is present and not withdrawn ($300 MIST, issuecomment-1149197275, kasumi-1, 2022-06-07) and there is no competing work (open PRs are only #61 graph_farms and #28 harvest_all; the issue timeline holds no cross-reference and a repo-wide PR search for 107 returns nothing). The report says that with MetaMask + a Trezor One the confirmation pop-up closes before the device ever signs, on MistSwap and TangoSwap (both SmartBCH) while SushiSwap on Ethereum mainnet works. That exact symptom is a long-standing third-party defect, not a defect of this tree: trezor/connect#784 'Metamask + Trezor pop up window automatically closes without signing' (open, 143 comments, reported against Uniswap/ETH, Polygon, Avalanche and Harmony; the only working remedies in that thread are device-side - firmware downgrade, disabled safety checks, another wallet) and MetaMask/metamask-extension#10896 'MetaMask Pop-up Window Always Unexpectedly Closes Right Before Entering PIN on Hardware Wallet' (labels area-hardware, hardware-trezor; reproduction step 'Approve/Swap on, e.g., Uniswap'). The repository's write paths carry no hardware-wallet-specific signing: swaps go through ethers signer.sendTransaction (src/hooks/useSwapCallback.ts:351-361), approvals through tokenContract.approve (src/hooks/useApproveCallback.ts:91-100) and wraps through deposit/withdraw (src/hooks/useWrapCallback.ts:56-59,83-85); all are plain eth_sendTransaction calls. The only non-standard signing path (provider.isMetaMask=false plus eth_sign, src/hooks/useSwapCallback.ts:418-481) is Archer-relay-only and Archer is switched off for this deployment (doArcher/archerRelay = undefined, src/pages/exchange/swap/[[...tokens]].tsx:127-129; ARCHER_RELAY_URI = {}, src/config/archer.ts:5-6). A direct diff of this hook against its parent interface (snkashis/sushiswap-interface@master) shows the transaction path is identical except for a fork-only forced legacy fee (gasPrice: getGasPrice(), 1.05 Gwei, src/functions/trade.ts:44-51); that value equals SmartBCH's protocol minimum and editing it would be a speculative change with a real risk of underpriced ordinary swaps, not a fix, and it cannot be validated here because the configured RPC (src/config/rpc.ts:4) does not answer and the project is defunct (app.mistswap.fi redirects to a parked domain-sale listing, no commits since 2022). Reproducing the reported abort needs a physical Trezor One bound to a MetaMask hardware account, which this runner does not have, so no honest red-then-green repository test can exist for a fault that lives in the MetaMask <-> Trezor Connect bridge. (Context, not the refusal reason: the repo's own unit suite is not runnable at base either - .github/workflows/tests.yaml:64 runs 'yarn test', package.json has no test script, and jest is absent from package.json and yarn.lock.) Checkout left unchanged: master at 0229c7e2ac16aabe898d210d9ce22837d6c7d134, working tree clean, no fix branch created, no product edits. Unblocking evidence would be an interface-side log or traceback, or a device-backed reproduction, showing the abort originates in this codebase.
